thread:
SupportTech: FYI customer acme-42 reported a sudden spike in billable tokens and a stream of `JSON parse` errors this morning. Happened right after a model update rollout.
OncallBot: Alert: parse_failure_rate > 5% for /v1/generate (region: us-west-2) — triggered at 2024-06-15T09:12:03Z
SupportTech: Customer repro steps: POST to /v1/generate with `json_mode: true` and this payload (they said it was generated by their templating engine):
```
{"items": [
  {"id": "1", "query": "Summarize the document",},
  {"id": "2", "query": "Extract entities"}
]}
```
SupportTech: Note the trailing comma on the first object — leads to `Unexpected token` from our parse middleware. They said their client retries automatically (3x) and also falls back to `text` mode on failure which increased token usage.
Maria (support): They shared a snippet of logs from our API proxy: `parse_json_error: Unexpected token at position 45`, `client_id=acme-42`, `fallback_used=true`, `tokens_charged=4820`. Customer is upset about the bill jump.
Alex (eng-runtime): I can see the same error pattern in traces. The parser error is thrown in json-mode post-processor before any schema validation. We currently log the raw model output and the parse error.
Priya (obs): Copy of relevant trace span: `request -> model -> parse-json -> error`. Latency spikes correlate with retries: parse error path increases end-to-end latency by ~300ms per retry. Dashboard shows a parse_failure_rate spike at 09:10–09:20.
Jason (security): Heads-up — logs currently contain the raw model output including user-provided strings. That may include PII. We need to redact before persisting.
SupportTech: Customer asked for an itemized breakdown: which requests failed parsing, how many retried, and whether we can void the extra tokens billed.
Priya (obs): Actionable monitoring items: increment a counter `jsonmode.parse_failures_total{client}` and a histogram `jsonmode.parse_latency_ms`. Also add a tag for `fallback_used=true/false`. Right now we only have a generic `parse_errors` gauge.
Alex (eng-runtime): Short-term fix: fail fast and return structured error that includes `parse_error` with the exact snippet (redacted) and `suggested_repro` so clients can patch templating. I can PR a change to the parse middleware to include a redacted `offending_text` and a `hint` like `trailing_comma` detection.
Maria (support): For billing, we should surface retry counts per request in the request log. Support can then export the list and offer credits for retries due to server-side parsing.
SupportTech: Repro checklist I ran locally: 1) send payload above; 2) enable `json_mode:true`; 3) see `parse_json_error` in response body; 4) client library retries by default -> additional calls billed.
Alex (eng-runtime): I'm concerned about silent schema drift too — if model output changes shape we sometimes still parse (loose mode) but produce incorrect typed values. We should emit a `schema_mismatch` metric when the parsed object doesn't pass the registered schema.
Priya (obs): Dashboard proposal: new panel on `Structured Output` section showing parse_failure_rate, parse_latency_p95, fallback_rate, and tokens_billed_per_parse_path (success vs fallback). Add an annotation for deploy at 09:05 so we can correlate.
Jason (security): For redaction: add a pipeline step before logging that blanks values matching regexes for email, ssn, credit_card, and limits raw snippet length to 512 chars. Record a hash of the snippet for debugging if needed.
Maria (support): I'll ask the customer to provide a sample failing request_id list (they have 14) and propose a billing credit for the excess tokens caused by client retries + fallback.
SupportTech: Proposed short-term runbook: 1) Obs: add parse counters & tag fallback; 2) Eng: implement redaction + hint in parse error (PR in progress by Alex); 3) Support: prepare credit calc template and customer comms.
Alex (eng-runtime): I opened PR #7892 with a change to attach `parse_hint` and `redacted_snippet` to errors. It will include tests for trailing commas and unclosed arrays. Hoping for review today.
Priya (obs): I'll add the counters and a dashboard card; ETA 2 hours.
Jason (security): I'll review the redaction approach; want to ensure hashes are HMAC'd with per-tenant key.
Maria (support): Customer expecting an update in 4 hours. I'll take point on comms.
SupportTech: Assigning owners: Alex -> parse error payloads (eng-runtime), Priya -> metrics & dashboard (obs), Jason -> redaction review (security), Maria -> customer comms & billing credits (support).
Alex (eng-runtime): Quick note — can we also include a small `schema_example` in error responses to help customers fix templates faster?
SupportTech: Good idea. Maria, include that in the reply.
Priya (obs): Dashboard alert rule: fire when `jsonmode.parse_failures_total` rises by >200% over baseline in 5m and fallback_rate > 1%.
SupportTech: I'll follow up with a ticket linking the customer request, PR, and dashboard changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maria (support): Thanks team, updating the customer now.
